instruction: Warehouse And Office Annex Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 2 spaces and 2 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Warehouse and Office Annex. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 13 total OS:Surface objects, split into 2 floor surfaces, 2 roof/ceiling surfaces and 9 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 2 Ground, 9 Outdoors and 2 Surface. Add 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 17.60 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 2 ideal-loads air systems, 2 zone HVAC equipment lists and 2 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 28.00 m in X, 12.00 m in Y and 6.00 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 288.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 435.20 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
